statement: For s>3, L>=2 and 0<|delta|<=1/4, displacing one particle of the simple-cubic L-torus lattice under the absolutely periodized pair potential |x|^{-s} destroys exact periodicity but changes total energy by at most C_s|delta| independently of L, with C_s=s(4/3)^(s+1)sum_{m in Z^3 minus {0}}|m|^{-s-1}.
assumptions: N=L^3, one particle at each site of (Z/LZ)^3
periodized pair energy H_L=sum_{i<j}sum_{n in Z^3}|x_i-x_j+nL|^{-s}

source.basis: mean-value theorem and convergent lattice sum

proof_or_counterexample: Pairs not touching moved particle cancel. Index remaining periodized pairs by m in Z^3 minus LZ^3. Mean-value theorem gives each difference <=s|delta|(|m|-|delta|)^{-s-1}<=s(4/3)^{s+1}|delta||m|^{-s-1}. The full Z^3 sum converges for s>2.

remaining_gap: This only invalidates a volume-order energy gap against every nonexact lattice configuration. It gives no phase construction, lattice optimality, DLR verification, or defect entropy bound.
